content_1_cn (左侧/主内容):
### 项目概况及背景
上海当代艺术博物馆 (PSA) 选址于2010年上海世博会未来馆，前身是始建于1897年的南市发电厂。作为中国大陆第一家公立当代艺术博物馆，项目坐落于上海黄浦江畔。照明设计突破传统高对比度束缚，采用明亮、简洁的现代光环境策略，实现艺术品与观众之间的视觉互动，打造上海城市文化新地标。
content_1 _en(左侧/主内容):
### Project Overview
Located along the Huangpu River, Shanghai Power Station of Art (PSA) is housed in the former Pavilion of Future of the 2010 Shanghai Expo, originally the Nanshi Power Plant (1897). As mainland China's first public contemporary art museum, the lighting design breaks away from traditional high-contrast constraints, adopting a bright, concise modern light environment to foster visual interaction between artworks and audiences.

content_1_cn (左侧/主内容):
### 尊重历史的工业回响
在历史建筑的改造中，光线是最柔和的刻刀。设计团队不仅保留了南市发电厂原有的粗犷工业结构，更通过隐蔽的轨道照明与大尺度的均匀泛光，让历经沧桑的钢筋水泥在现代艺术的语境下重新呼吸，实现了工业遗迹与当代审美的跨时空对话。
content_1 _en(左侧/主内容):
### Industrial Echoes Respecting History
In the renovation of historical buildings, light acts as the gentlest carving knife. The design team preserved the original rough industrial structure of the Nanshi Power Plant, using concealed track lighting and large-scale uniform floodlighting to allow the weathered reinforced concrete to breathe again in the context of modern art.
content_2_cn (右侧/次内容):
### 突破传统的观展光环境
传统的博物馆往往采用极暗的背景与高对比度的聚光来突出展品，而 PSA 的照明设计则反其道而行之。以明亮、简洁的高雅光环境为主调，既缓解了长时间观展的视觉疲劳，又为观众提供了一个可以放松交流的驻足空间，让光、艺术品与人融为一体。
content_2_en (右侧/次内容):
### Breaking Traditional Exhibition Lighting
Traditional museums often use extremely dark backgrounds and high-contrast spotlights to highlight exhibits. The lighting design at PSA takes a different approach. Dominated by a bright, concise, and elegant light environment, it relieves visual fatigue from long-term viewing and provides audiences with a relaxing space to pause and interact.

content_1_cn (左侧/主内容):
### 自然光与人工光的平衡共生
空间顶部的天窗系统被巧妙利用。通过智能调光系统，室内人工照明能够根据引入的室外自然光的强弱进行实时补偿。这种克制而精确的光学策略，不仅极大地节约了能源，更为那些对光照敏感的珍贵展品提供了严密的保护层。
content_1 _en(左侧/主内容):
### Symbiosis of Natural and Artificial Light
The skylight system at the top of the space is ingeniously utilized. Through an intelligent dimming system, indoor artificial lighting can perform real-time compensation based on the intensity of natural light introduced from outside. This restrained and precise optical strategy not only saves energy but also provides a strict protective layer for light-sensitive exhibits.

content_1_cn (左侧/主内容): *昔日的工业巨炉，如今在当代光影的拥吻下，重获新生。*
content_1 _en(左侧/主内容): *The former industrial furnace is now reborn under the embrace of contemporary light and shadow.*

content_1_cn (左侧/主内容):
### 唤醒工业时代的城市记忆
南京白云亭文化艺术中心改建项目，建筑幕墙大面积使用了折扇型的银灰色冲孔铝板。照明设计意图在夜间延续建筑形体的通透感，通过在幕墙背后的框架结构上设置LED线条灯具形成内部背光。反射光透过冲孔铝板，使整体建筑在南京的夜色中犹如一盏轻盈明亮的灯笼。
content_1 _en(左侧/主内容):
### Awakening Urban Memories of the Industrial Era
The Nanjing Baiyunting Cultural and Art Center renovation features folded fan-shaped silver-gray perforated aluminum panels. The lighting design continues the building's transparency at night by installing LED linear lights behind the curtain wall for internal backlighting. Reflected light passing through the panels transforms the architecture into a luminous lantern in the Nanjing night.

content_1_cn (左侧/主内容):
### 昔日冷藏厂的华丽转身
项目前身为南京市冷冻厂，如今已蜕变为占地2.5万平方米的城市地标。照明团队从建筑的“折扇”理念中汲取灵感，摒弃了传统的外投光模式，转而采用内透光的表现手法，赋予了这座巨型建筑轻盈、呼吸的视觉质感。
content_1 _en(左侧/主内容):
### The Gorgeous Transformation of a Former Cold Storage
Formerly the Nanjing Cold Storage Factory, the project has transformed into a 25,000 sqm urban landmark. Inspired by the architectural 'folded fan' concept, the lighting team abandoned traditional external floodlighting in favor of an internal glow, endowing this massive structure with a lightweight, breathing visual texture.
content_2_cn (右侧/次内容):
### 折扇幕墙与光影灯笼
光效的核心在于铝板背后的隐秘打光。柔和的LED光源经过墙面反射，透过不同孔径的穿孔铝板溢出，形成一种类似古代“纸灯笼”的温润光晕。在夜空下，建筑如同漂浮在城市上空的巨型折纸艺术品。
content_2_en (右侧/次内容):
### Folded Fan Curtain Wall and Shadow Lantern
The core of the light effect lies in the concealed illumination behind the aluminum panels. Soft LED sources reflect off the walls and spill through the varying apertures of the perforated panels, creating a warm halo similar to an ancient 'paper lantern'. At night, it resembles a giant origami artwork floating above the city.

content_1_cn (左侧/主内容):
### 内部空间的光学引导
步入建筑内部，自然光与人工光的交织构成了参观的动线。中央的中庭采用了高耸的采光顶，照明设计补充了柔和的漫反射光，确保即使在阴雨天气或夜间，市民依然能感受到如户外般开阔、明朗的公共文化氛围。
content_1 _en(左侧/主内容):
### Optical Guidance in the Interior Space
Stepping inside, the interplay of natural and artificial light forms the circulation path. The central atrium features a towering skylight. The lighting design supplements this with soft, diffuse reflection, ensuring that even on rainy days or at night, citizens can experience an open, bright public cultural atmosphere akin to the outdoors.

content_1_cn (左侧/主内容): *不露声色的光影，于无声处诉说设计的力量与建筑生命的延续。*
content_1 _en(左侧/主内容): *Unobtrusive light and shadow silently narrate the power of design and the continuation of architectural life.*

content_1_cn (左侧/主内容):
### 探索自然生态的生命之光
上海自然博物馆建筑灵感源于“螺”的壳体结构。设计秉持视觉展示、生态科学与低碳绿色的三大原则，创新性地将自然光引入室内展陈。通过智能控制系统与透视幕帘，完美平衡博物馆的室内人工光与室外自然采光，针对珍稀标本精准控制曝光量，在上海市中心打造出极具呼吸感的自然探索空间。
content_1 _en(左侧/主内容):
### Exploring the Light of Life in Natural Ecology
Inspired by the nautilus shell, the Shanghai Natural History Museum integrates natural daylight as a primary exhibition light source. Adhering to visual display, ecological science, and low-carbon design, intelligent controls and perspective curtains balance indoor artificial lighting with outdoor daylight. It creates an immersive, breathing natural exploration space in downtown Shanghai while controlling exposure for specimens.

content_1_cn (左侧/主内容):
### 源自鹦鹉螺的生态演进
建筑外观与内部动线如同鹦鹉螺般盘旋而下，隐喻了地球生命的演化历程。照明设计不再局限于被动的黑盒子展陈，而是大胆拥抱自然光。在“起源之谜”与“生命长河”展区，阳光穿透巨大的玻璃幕墙倾泻而下，让远古化石在自然节律中焕发生机。
content_1 _en(左侧/主内容):
### Ecological Evolution from the Nautilus
The architecture spirals downwards like a nautilus, metaphorically representing the evolutionary history of life on Earth. The lighting design moves beyond passive black-box exhibitions, boldly embracing natural daylight. In the 'Mystery of Origin' and 'River of Life' zones, sunlight cascades through massive glass walls, bringing ancient fossils to life within nature's rhythm.
content_2_cn (右侧/次内容):
### 严苛的珍贵标本滤光保护
自然光是一把双刃剑。为了防止紫外线和强光对脆弱动植物标本造成不可逆的损害，团队引入了高科技的智能卷帘与自适应调光设备。通过精确的光通量计算，实现了视觉通透感与展品文物保护之间的绝佳平衡，做到了真正的生态照明。
content_2_en (右侧/次内容):
### Strict Light Filtration for Rare Specimens
Natural light is a double-edged sword. To prevent irreversible UV and harsh light damage to fragile flora and fauna specimens, the team introduced high-tech smart blinds and adaptive dimming. Through precise luminous flux calculations, they achieved a perfect balance between visual transparency and artifact conservation—true ecological lighting.

content_1_cn (左侧/主内容):
### 探索微观与宏观的光影视角
在“生存智慧”及“生态万象”等地下展区，光线由开阔转向聚焦。高显色指数（CRI>95）的轨道聚光灯被精准投射到每一个微缩景观模型和标本上。低色温的光斑在昏暗的环境中勾勒出动物毛发的质感与骨骼的纹理，营造出极具戏剧张力与探索乐趣的科普微空间。
content_1 _en(左侧/主内容):
### Exploring Micro and Macro Light Perspectives
In underground zones like 'Survival Wisdom' and 'Ecological Panorama', the light shifts from open to focused. High-CRI (CRI>95) track spotlights are precisely aimed at every diorama and specimen. Low-color-temperature light spots trace the textures of animal fur and bone patterns in the dim environment, creating a highly dramatic and engaging educational micro-space.

content_1_cn (左侧/主内容): *以光为引，穿越亿万年的时光长河，在明暗之间触碰自然生命的脉搏。*
content_1 _en(左侧/主内容): *Guided by light, crossing billions of years in the river of time, touching the pulse of natural life amidst light and shadow.*

content_1_cn (左侧/主内容):
### 探索未来的科技地标
位于广州天河区的小鹏汽车新总部大楼，以极具辨识度的建筑语言诠释未来出行理念。照明设计巧妙地将小鹏专属的“X”品牌符号隐匿于建筑横向肌理之中，通过智能幕墙照明展现充满科幻感与前卫感的立面夜景，以光影铸就大湾区智能制造的全新视觉名片。
content_1 _en(左侧/主内容):
### A Tech Landmark Exploring the Future
Located in Tianhe, Guangzhou, the new XPeng Motors Headquarters interprets future mobility through highly recognizable architectural language. The lighting design ingeniously embeds the exclusive 'X' brand symbol within the horizontal textures, presenting a sci-fi and avant-garde facade nightscape, forging a new visual business card for Greater Bay Area smart manufacturing.

content_1_cn (左侧/主内容):
### 隐匿于肌理的品牌符号X
设计打破了传统办公楼千篇一律的夜景模式，将建筑幕墙的横向百叶作为光的载体。在光线的编排上，小鹏汽车标志性的“X”元素被巧妙地转化为灯光代码，在夜间以动态或静谧的形式浮现。这种“见光不见灯”的处理手法，使得建筑本身成为了一件巨型的品牌灯光装置。
content_1 _en(左侧/主内容):
### The Brand Symbol X Hidden in Textures
The design breaks the monotonous night view of traditional office buildings by using the facade's horizontal louvers as light carriers. In the choreography, XPeng's iconic 'X' element is cleverly transformed into light codes, surfacing dynamically or statically at night. This 'seeing the light, not the fixture' approach turns the building into a massive brand light installation.
content_2_cn (右侧/次内容):
### 室内极简的工业质感空间
呼应外观的科技属性，室内的光环境设计同样克制而极简。在车辆展示大厅中，纯粹的高亮度面光源如天空般均光洒落，完美勾勒出汽车工业设计的流线与金属光泽。办公区域则采用了高品质的防眩光线性照明，为员工提供了一个高效、清晰且富有灵感的工作环境。
content_2_en (右侧/次内容):
### Minimalist Industrial Textured Interiors
Echoing the exterior's tech attributes, the interior light environment is equally restrained and minimalist. In the vehicle showroom, pure, high-brightness planar light sources scatter evenly like the sky, flawlessly outlining the automotive streamlines and metallic luster. Office areas utilize high-quality anti-glare linear lighting, providing an efficient and inspiring workspace.

content_1_cn (左侧/主内容):
### 动静结合的城市脉搏
作为城市天际线的一部分，塔冠的照明通过编程式控制系统，能够根据节日、活动或企业重要时刻展现多维度的色彩律动。它不再是一栋静态的建筑，而是一个能够与广州这座城市同频共振、具有数字生命的未来发光体。
content_1 _en(左侧/主内容):
### Dynamic and Static Urban Pulse
As part of the city skyline, the crown lighting employs a programmable control system capable of displaying multi-dimensional color rhythms for holidays or important corporate moments. It is no longer a static building but a futuristic luminous body with digital life, resonating at the same frequency as the city of Guangzhou.

content_1_cn (左侧/主内容): *让光成为未来的引擎，以数字的脉动照亮通往明日的探索之路。*
content_1 _en(左侧/主内容): *Let light become the engine of the future, illuminating the path of exploration to tomorrow with a digital pulse.*

content_1_cn (左侧/主内容):
### 雅致江南的光影礼赞
苏州锦溪示范区将高端人居体验与江南地域文化无缝嫁接。住宅与样板间照明设计遵循“以光为诗”的理念，摒弃繁复的直接光源，大面积运用洗墙灯带与重点照明。柔和的光晕在高级定制的材质表面流转，塑造了优雅静谧的空间格调，彰显了高端圈层对私密性与生活质感的极致追求。
content_1 _en(左侧/主内容):
### An Ode to Elegant Jiangnan Light and Shadow
The Suzhou Jinxi Demonstration Zone seamlessly grafts luxury residential experiences with regional Jiangnan culture. The residential and sample room lighting design follows the 'light as poetry' philosophy, discarding complex direct sources for extensive wall-washing strips and accent lighting. Soft halos dance across custom materials, shaping an elegant and tranquil spatial tone.

content_1_cn (左侧/主内容):
### 水墨江南与现代奢居的碰撞
设计初衷旨在让古老的水乡文化在当代建筑空间中复苏。室内光线如同挥洒的水墨，在木饰面、石材与金属之间轻柔流转。低色温（2700K-3000K）光源的大量使用，成功营造出一种内敛、含蓄却极富温情的高级居住体验，仿佛将室外的朦胧月色请入了内室。
content_1 _en(左侧/主内容):
### Collision of Ink-Wash Jiangnan and Modern Luxury
The design intent revives ancient water-town culture within contemporary architectural spaces. Indoor light flows gently like splashed ink across wood veneers, stone, and metal. The extensive use of low color temperature (2700K-3000K) sources successfully creates a restrained, subtle, yet highly affectionate premium living experience, as if inviting hazy moonlight indoors.
content_2_cn (右侧/次内容):
### 见光不见灯的雅致氛围
极致的奢华往往藏于细节的克制中。为了保持空间的纯粹感，灯具被巧妙地隐藏在天花暗槽、地脚线与陈列柜内。通过细致的光学透镜计算，光线精准地洗刷墙面、点亮艺术摆件，避免了任何突兀的眩光干扰，在不经意间勾勒出居住者卓尔不凡的生活品味。
content_2_en (右侧/次内容):
### Elegant Vibe of Seeing Light, Not Fixtures
Ultimate luxury often hides in restrained details. To maintain spatial purity, fixtures are cleverly hidden in ceiling coves, baseboards, and display cabinets. Through meticulous optical lens calculations, light precisely washes walls and illuminates art pieces, avoiding any abrupt glare interference, inadvertently outlining the residents' extraordinary lifestyle taste.

content_1_cn (左侧/主内容):
### 模糊内外的边界感
落地大窗与户外的庭院景观形成了视觉上的连续体。夜间的庭院景观照明秉持同样的低调作风，以低矮的草坪灯与树木投光为主，光效逐层向外递减。这种光环境的延续性，不仅消融了建筑的物理边界，更让居住者在夜晚获得被自然包裹的安全感与归属感。
content_1 _en(左侧/主内容):
### Blurring the Boundaries of Inside and Out
Floor-to-ceiling windows and outdoor courtyard landscapes form a visual continuum. The nighttime landscape lighting adheres to the same low-profile style, dominated by low lawn lights and tree uplighting, with light effects diminishing outwards. This continuity of the light environment dissolves physical boundaries, granting residents a sense of security wrapped in nature.

content_1_cn (左侧/主内容): *借一缕清辉，入梦烟雨江南；用光影的留白，书写现代人居的静谧篇章。*
content_1 _en(左侧/主内容): *Borrowing a ray of moonlight to dream of misty Jiangnan; using the negative space of light and shadow to write a tranquil chapter of modern living.*

content_1_cn (左侧/主内容):
### 极致感官的飨宴之光
坐落于上海太古汇镛舍酒店内的随堂里中餐厅，将高定餐饮体验推向了极致。室内照明深谙高级餐饮的光学心理，通过超低色温与极高显色性光源的大面积运用，营造出私密、内敛却极具食欲诱惑力的餐区环境。精细的桌面聚光与环境弱光形成对比，让每一道佳肴都在光影流转中成为艺术品。
content_1 _en(左侧/主内容):
### The Light of an Ultimate Sensory Feast
Located within The Middle House at Taikoo Hui, Shanghai, the Sui Tang Li Chinese restaurant elevates haute dining to the extreme. The interior lighting profoundly understands the optical psychology of fine dining. Through the extensive use of ultra-low color temperature and high CRI light sources, it creates a private, restrained, yet highly appetizing dining environment. Fine table spotlighting contrasts with dim ambient light, turning every dish into a work of art.

content_1_cn (左侧/主内容):
### 高级餐饮的光学心理战
在随堂里，灯光不仅仅是照明工具，更是情绪的催化剂。整体空间采用了2700K的极暖色温，这种类似于烛光的色彩基调，瞬间拉近了就餐者之间的心理距离。大面积的暗环境背景消解了公共空间的嘈杂感，为每一桌宾客在光学上建立了一道隐形的私密屏风。
content_1 _en(左侧/主内容):
### Optical Psychology of Fine Dining
At Sui Tang Li, lighting is not just an illumination tool but an emotional catalyst. The overall space uses an extremely warm 2700K color temperature; this candle-like tone instantly bridges the psychological distance between diners. The large dark background dissolves the noise of the public space, establishing an invisible optical screen of privacy for each table.
content_2_cn (右侧/次内容):
### 让食物如艺术品般呈现
桌面是整个餐厅唯一的绝对视觉焦点。显色指数(CRI)高达95以上的定制射灯精准捕捉餐盘的范围。当浓郁的高饱和度菜肴被聚光灯照亮时，其色泽与纹理得到了最大程度的还原与放大，光线仿佛化身为“天然滤镜”，极大地刺激了食客的味蕾与食欲。
content_2_en (右侧/次内容):
### Presenting Food as Artwork
The tabletop is the only absolute visual focus in the entire restaurant. Custom spotlights with a CRI over 95 precisely target the plate area. When rich, highly saturated dishes are illuminated by the spotlight, their colors and textures are maximally restored and amplified. The light acts as a 'natural filter', immensely stimulating diners' taste buds and appetite.

content_1_cn (左侧/主内容):
### 海派元素的光影重塑
餐厅设计融合了上海石库门的复古元素与 Art Deco 几何语言。照明在此并未宣兵夺主，而是顺应建筑的肌理，在隔断、吧台与走廊处施以极其微弱的间接照明（仅5-15lux），让那些精致的黄铜、绒面与老木头在暗光中泛出岁月的低调奢华，构建出极具摩登感的海派东方美学。
content_1 _en(左侧/主内容):
### Shadow Reshaping of Shanghai-Style Elements
The restaurant design blends vintage Shanghai Shikumen elements with Art Deco geometric language. The lighting does not overpower but follows the architectural texture, applying extremely dim indirect illumination (only 5-15 lux) to partitions, bars, and corridors. Exquisite brass, velvet, and old wood emit a low-key luxury of age in the dim light, constructing a highly modern Shanghai-style Oriental aesthetic.

content_1_cn (左侧/主内容): *在推杯换盏的流光中，品味到的不仅是珍馐美馔，更是被光影精心雕琢的曼妙时光。*
content_1 _en(左侧/主内容): *In the flowing light of clinking glasses, what one tastes is not just delicacies, but the graceful time meticulously carved by light and shadow.*

content_1_cn (左侧/主内容):
### 重塑明代风华的沉浸街区
南京金陵长乐坊作为历史文化街区商业焕新的代表，照明设计深谙古建保护与现代审美的平衡之道。通过定制的暖光调色系统，温润的红光被巧妙用于重塑明代建筑风情；宫灯造型的创新运用与光影的交织，打造出让人仿佛穿越时空的沉浸式文旅空间，赋予历史街区在夜晚全新的生命力与商业价值。
content_1 _en(左侧/主内容):
### Immersive District Reshaping Ming Dynasty Elegance
As a representative of historical and cultural district renewal, the Nanjing Jinling Changlefang lighting design deeply understands the balance between ancient architecture preservation and modern aesthetics. Using a custom warm-light tuning system, gentle red hues ingeniously resurrect the Ming Dynasty architectural charm. The innovative use of palace lantern motifs interlaced with dynamic shadows crafts a time-traveling immersive cultural tourism space.

content_1_cn (左侧/主内容):
### 一梦回金陵的叙事光影
原为90年代针织内衣厂旧址的长乐坊，如今被改造成新中式园林商业街区。照明设计以“科举赴考-金榜题名”为动线叙事轴心。从入口牌坊的庄重投光，到深巷中摇曳的定制宫灯，光影犹如一条隐形的红线，牵引着游人步步深入，体验一场跨越六百年的金陵幻梦。
content_1 _en(左侧/主内容):
### Narrative Lighting: A Dream Back to Jinling
Formerly a 1990s knitting factory, Changlefang is now a Neo-Chinese garden commercial district. The lighting design uses 'Heading for Exams - Attaining Scholarly Honor' as the narrative axis for circulation. From the solemn floodlights at the entrance archway to the swaying custom palace lanterns in deep alleys, light acts as an invisible thread, guiding visitors to experience a Jinling illusion spanning 600 years.
content_2_cn (右侧/次内容):
### 繁华商街与静谧园林的平衡
商铺、转角与内庭院的光环境处理极其考究。沿街商铺采用高显色性的内透光吸引客流，而一旦转入内苑，照度瞬间降维，仅以低矮的草坪灯与水景洗墙灯勾勒出假山流水与亭台楼阁。这种明暗交织的节奏感，既满足了现代商业的活力需求，又守住了古建园林应有的静谧与雅致。
content_2_en (右侧/次内容):
### Balancing Bustling Streets and Tranquil Gardens
The light environment for shops, corners, and inner courtyards is extremely refined. Street-facing shops use high-CRI internal glow to attract traffic, but upon entering the inner garden, illuminance drops instantly, using only low lawn lights and water feature wall-washers to trace rockeries and pavilions. This rhythmic interplay of light and dark satisfies modern commercial vitality while preserving the tranquility of ancient gardens.

content_1_cn (左侧/主内容):
### 古建材质的精准渲染
朱红的柱漆、青灰的瓦片、温润的木雕，在夜间如何真实还原？RDI照明团队经过多轮现场样板测试，最终选定了特定波段的暖白光结合局部红光谱补正。光线抚过飞檐翘角，不仅没有生硬的“仿古”做作感，反而激发出历史材质本身的温润质感，让古典文化在夜色中鲜活复苏。
content_1 _en(左侧/主内容):
### Precise Rendering of Ancient Materials
How to authentically restore crimson pillar paint, slate-gray tiles, and warm wood carvings at night? After multiple on-site mockups, the RDI lighting team selected specific bands of warm white light combined with localized red spectrum correction. Light brushes over the upturned eaves, leaving no stiff 'fake antique' feeling, but rather stimulating the warm texture of the historical materials themselves.

content_1 _en(左侧/主内容): *Old factories and alleys transform into a flourishing landscape; holding a lantern, we embrace the prosperity of a millennium ago deep within the light and shadow.*

content_1_cn (左侧/主内容):
### 梦幻般的夜间生态剧场
上海世博文化公园温室馆，是一座集自然景观与前卫建筑于一体的都市绿洲。照明设计在这里承担了重塑“夜间自然”的使命，通过极高精度的光束投射与色彩渐变控制，植物群落在夜色中焕发出奇幻的生命张力。室内光影不仅满足了生态照明需求，更上演了一场沉浸式的植物光影秀，为城市公共景观照明树立了新标杆。
content_1 _en(左侧/主内容):
### A Dreamlike Nocturnal Ecological Theater
The Shanghai Expo Culture Park Greenhouse is an urban oasis blending natural landscapes with avant-garde architecture. The lighting design takes on the mission of reinventing 'nocturnal nature'. Through ultra-precise beam projection and gradient color control, the flora radiates a magical vitality at night. The interior illumination stages an immersive botanical light show, setting a new benchmark for urban landscape lighting.

content_1_cn (左侧/主内容):
### 越界自然的光影重塑
植物生长的自然规律在夜晚被暂时“悬置”，取而代之的是一场由算法与光学交织的艺术盛宴。海市沙洲馆中，高精度的投光灯将深邃的蓝紫色光晕洒向沙漠植物区，粗犷的仙人掌在冷色调的勾勒下显得奇幻而神秘，彻底颠覆了人们对植物夜间形态的固有认知。
content_1 _en(左侧/主内容):
### Reshaping Nature Beyond Boundaries
The natural laws of plant growth are temporarily 'suspended' at night, replaced by an art feast interwoven with algorithms and optics. In the Mirage Desert Pavilion, high-precision floodlights cast profound blue-purple halos onto the desert flora. Rough cacti appear magical and mysterious outlined in cool tones, completely subverting conventional perceptions of nocturnal plant forms.
content_2_cn (右侧/次内容):
### 移步换景的沉浸式游园
光影跟随着游人的步调在空间中流转。从“峡谷飞瀑”的动态波纹光，到“云上森林”中透过树冠洒落的迷离斑驳，每一个展区都有专属的光影情感剧本。通过隐藏在岩石、水下与高空栈道底部的灯具，设计团队完美消解了工业设备的冰冷感，让光仿佛是从自然地貌中自然生长出来的精灵。
content_2_en (右侧/次内容):
### Immersive Garden Strolling with Changing Views
Light and shadow flow through the space following the visitors' pace. From the dynamic ripple lights of the 'Canyon Waterfall' to the dappled beams falling through the canopy in the 'Cloud Forest', each zone has a dedicated lighting emotion script. By hiding fixtures in rocks, underwater, and under elevated walkways, the team perfectly dissolved industrial coldness, making light appear as elves organically grown from the natural landscape.

content_1_cn (左侧/主内容):
### 超越植物照明的光学挑战
在充满高湿度与复杂水景的温室环境中，灯具的防眩光、防水防腐蚀以及散热面临着极限挑战。团队不仅要确保植物在人工光干预下的健康生长，还要防止乱反射的杂光破坏玻璃穹顶外部的纯净夜景。这是一个融合了园艺学、光学与建筑工程学的跨界壮举。
content_1 _en(左侧/主内容):
### Optical Challenges Beyond Botanical Lighting
In a greenhouse environment filled with high humidity and complex waterscapes, anti-glare, waterproofing, corrosion resistance, and heat dissipation of fixtures faced extreme challenges. The team not only had to ensure the healthy growth of plants under artificial light intervention but also prevent stray reflections from ruining the pure night view outside the glass dome. This is a crossover feat blending horticulture, optics, and architectural engineering.

content_1 _en(左侧/主内容): *The lungs of the city breathe in the night; light and green interweave into a romantic hymn dedicated to the future Earth.*

### 中原夜空的地标图腾
郑州绿地千玺广场高达280米，建筑外形充满东方神韵。照明设计不仅解决了高空酒店大堂的自然采光难题，更通过塔顶反射材料将阳光引入中庭。夜幕降临，塔顶镜面结合灯光呈现烟花般璀璨的形态；外立面通过隐藏式泛光照明与精准光束角控制，勾勒出玲珑剔透的建筑肌理，使其成为郑州最具代表性的超高层地标夜景。
content_1 _en(左侧/主内容):
### A Landmark Totem in the Central Plains Night Sky
Standing 280 meters tall with an Oriental aesthetic, the Zhengzhou Greenland Center solves natural daylighting for the high-altitude hotel lobby by using mirror reflectors. At night, the crown transforms into a luminous firework display. Concealed floodlighting outlines the building's intricate facade, establishing it as Zhengzhou's most iconic supertall landmark.

content_1_cn (左侧/主内容):
### 自然采光的大胆实验
在SOM担纲的建筑结构之上，如何为塔楼顶部深处的中庭引入阳光成为了一项巨大的挑战。照明设计团队突破常规，利用塔冠巨大的塔尖与幕墙顶部的镜面反射板，宛如一组宏大的光学仪器，将白昼的阳光层层折射引入室内，让高空大堂沐浴在生机勃勃的自然光中，不仅极大地节约了能源，更创造了独一无二的空间体验。
content_1 _en(左侧/主内容):
### A Bold Experiment in Natural Daylighting
On top of the architectural structure led by SOM, introducing sunlight into the deep atrium at the top of the tower posed a massive challenge. The lighting team broke conventions, utilizing the crown's massive spire and mirror reflectors at the curtain wall's top like a grand optical instrument. It refracts daylight into the interior, bathing the high-altitude lobby in vibrant natural light, saving energy and creating a unique spatial experience.
content_2_cn (右侧/次内容):
### 夜空中的璀璨烟花
当夜幕替代白昼，塔冠的镜面系统转变了它的角色。精心布置的LED投光设备自下而上照亮这些反射面，原本用于折射阳光的金属构件在夜空中迸发出夺目的光芒。整个建筑顶端宛如一朵正在中原大地上空华丽绽放的烟花，无论从城市哪个角落眺望，都是极具视觉冲击力的视觉图腾。
content_2_en (右侧/次内容):
### Brilliant Fireworks in the Night Sky
When night replaces day, the crown's mirror system shifts its role. Carefully arranged LED floodlights illuminate these reflective surfaces from below. The metal components, originally used to refract sunlight, burst with dazzling radiance in the night sky. The entire building top resembles a gorgeous firework blooming above the Central Plains, forming a highly impactful visual totem from any corner of the city.

content_1_cn (左侧/主内容):
### 玲珑剔透的立面洗礼
建筑的主体立面犹如层层叠叠的塔器。为了强化这一东方神韵，设计团队拒绝了平庸的全面泛光，而是根据上下幕墙结构的不同（上部较宽，下部收窄），精确匹配了不同光束角与安装位置的线型洗墙灯。灯具被完美隐藏在建筑肌理中，光线顺着立面倾泻而下，呈现出晶莹剔透、温润如玉的高级质感。
content_1 _en(左侧/主内容):
### Translucent Facade Baptism
The building's main facade resembles layered pagodas. To amplify this Oriental charm, the team rejected mediocre full floodlighting. Instead, based on the differing curtain wall structures (wider top, narrower bottom), they precisely matched linear wall washers with different beam angles and mounting positions. Hidden perfectly within the architectural texture, the light cascades down, presenting a translucent, jade-like premium texture.

The lighting design of FUSION GYM Donghai focuses on a fresh and simple modern texture. Through concealed indirect lighting and soft anti-glare processing, the space is not only suitable for professional training but also becomes an excellent visual check-in spot.

content_1_cn (左侧/主内容):
### 摄影友好的柔光镜面
在所有力量区的镜面周围均设置了漫反射侧光，犹如摄影棚的柔光箱，完美修饰了会员的面部与身形轮廓。
content_1 _en(左侧/主内容):
### Photography-friendly Soft Light Mirrors
Diffuse side lights are set around the mirrors in all strength areas, acting like softboxes in a photography studio, perfectly retouching members' facial and body contours.
content_2_cn (右侧/次内容):
### 导向性的光缝设计
走廊顶部连续的黑色光槽中内嵌射灯，结合墙面优美的弧线灯带，引导着动线向深处延伸。
content_2_en (右侧/次内容):
### Directional Light Slit Design
Spotlights embedded in the continuous black light slots at the top of the corridor, combined with the beautiful curved light strips on the wall, guide the circulation to extend deeper.

content_1_cn (左侧/主内容):
### 工业与现代的碰撞
在拳击区保留了硬朗的工业风天花，但在中央沙袋上方配置了高亮度的环形灯箱，用极致的现代几何光影统摄了粗犷的环境。
content_1 _en(左侧/主内容):
### Collision of Industry and Modernity
The tough industrial style ceiling is retained in the boxing area, but a high-brightness circular light box is configured above the central sandbag, dominating the rough environment with ultimate modern geometric light and shadow.
